B693/696 – Barrel Pit Storage Area: • Prepare 4200sf of floor down to bare concrete and 485sf of walls as needed by diamond grinding and removing any loose epoxy coating. • Apply one seal coat of Tera-Gem III Flex Primer with embedded fiberglass to 4200 sf of floor only, no walls. • Trowel at nominal ¼” 4200sf of floor only, no walls, using Tera-Gem III IFS. • Apply two pigmented seal coats of Tera-Gem III IFS Sealer to 4200 sf of floor and 4850sf of walls. • Apply one pigmented seal coat of Polyurethane 100 to 4200sf of floor and 485 sf of walls, color and finish texture will be selected by LLNL. LLNS will provide: • Removal of construction debris, providing Subcontractor with free, unobstructed access to work area. NOTES: • No new concrete has been poured at the jobsites, all concrete currently installed at the jobsites are older than 28 days and assumed to have less than 10lbs hydrostatic moisture. • A HEPA Filtration System is required to capture all dust generated by the grinding process. A Compliance Sticker, with expiration date, is required to be on all HEPA filtration systems. All workers shall be trained, fit-tested, and wear respirators while performing dust generating grinding work. B. ARTICLE 3 - PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE A. The Subcontractor may not commence any work subject to a JHA, Site-Specific Safety Plan, or Workplace Substance Abuse Program Plan (WSAPP) until the LLNS Contract Analyst issues a written Notice to Proceed authorizing release of the work. The LLNS Contract Analyst will not issue the Notice to Proceed until the Subcontractor has submitted, and LLNS has accepted, the submittals identified in the INCORPORATED DOCUMENTS Article, Paragraph B. The Notice to Proceed will direct the Subcontractor to coordinate the scheduling, training and release of the work with the LLNS Techncial Representative, and establish a completion date for the work.
